Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Intel Foundry Automation's (IFA) Automation Operations Team is looking for highly driven and disciplined individual to join our team as compressed work week shift engineer for supporting equipment performance and operations on day shift.
 
 Candidate will primarily be responsible for Automation application technical troubleshooting and operational support for the systems and software running in Intel's Factories. The candidate will also be expected to provide next-level support for certain applications for Intel's worldwide factory network. Some project work including insertion activity hardening and CIP software development is also part of the job scope.
 
 The ideal candidate must exhibit the following behavioral traits:
 Demonstrated initiative and to be self-directing and to work with minimal supervision.
 Be comfortable presenting issues and driving solutions utilizing formal education and judgement.
 Willing to produce results in a timely manner and adjust to rapidly changing priorities.
 
 Additionally, the candidate of choice will be willing to work a compressed work schedule: Working Shift 5
 Schedule: CWW Days - AM to PM, Sun-Tues + alternate Wed (12-hour shifts)
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Engineering or related STEM fields.
 6+ months of experience with scripting and related activities (SQL, Python, PowerShell, etc.)
 6+ months of experience in current IT technologies (Windows Server, ServiceNow, ITIL, Icloud, VMWare, etc.)
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Experienced with AI usage
 Resourceful, creative and innovative in coming out with ideas to resolve issues
 Good interpersonal and communication skills - must be able to communicate, clear message delivery in troubleshooting/swat bridge as well as written update on findings/investigation to factory users
 Ability to multitask and support across a broad range of applications.
 
           
 
 
 Job Type:
Intel Contract Employee 
 
 Shift:
Shift 5 (United States of America) 
 
 Primary Location: 
US, Oregon, Hillsboro 
 
 Additional Locations:
US, Arizona, Phoenix 
 
 
 
 Posting Statement:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. 
 Position of Trust
N/A 
 Benefits
 
 We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . 
  
  
Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $52,000.00-$200,000.00 (Hourly Role)  
  
The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations.
